release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.0.20

This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip contains LockStepPDF.exe and the matching _internal folder. The updater copies that program onto the file name already installed, including ReadySetPDF.exe. It does not remove folders already next to the program, so the LibreOffice folder from 4.0.15 stays and Office files still convert. This zip does not include LibreOffice.

JPEG, PNG, and TIFF files can be edited. Color, Rotate, Resize, Crop, Bleed, and Blank work on a single picture and on each frame of a multi-page TIFF. The file on disk stays as it is. The edited copy is a working PDF under the original name.

Pages can be dragged between a PDF and a picture. PNG, JPEG, and TIFF frames copy into the other file, and every frame of a multi-page TIFF can move in one drop. Dropping the file name still nests the whole file and leaves the original in the list. A nested picture shows in the preview. A page-setup step recorded for a file this preview did not open is skipped, so the preview can finish.

Multi-up, in the single-page view, no longer writes the word Cut on the preview. The trim box and crop marks stay. That word was not in the saved PDF.
